method: Resemblyzer GE2E 256-d embeddings of 2 s windows (1 s hop) of ElevenLabs TTS voices; every window passes through the B01 satellite channel (synthetic room, RT60 0.4 s, pink noise 30 dB). Household anna/mark/sam = Amanda/David/Ollie voices, enrolled on their first 10 s; remaining speech split in time into calibration (first half) and evaluation (second half). Guests: 4 TTS voices never enrolled, plus 3 LibriSpeech clips (real people) if available. Two identity tiers chosen on calibration by minimising expected cost, (1-pi)(FRR + c*MIS) + pi*c*FAR_guest, pi = 0.2, c = 1 (comfort) and 10 (named), named tier also with a top-1/top-2 margin. Replay = evaluation windows through phone / Bluetooth / hi-fi speaker proxies, then the room. Liveness = one-class z-score check on 6 channel features, fitted on calibration live windows only, threshold at 5 % live rejection. Challenge phrase modelled with transcripts. Overlap = two members' windows mixed at -6/0/+6 dB. All requests then go through islab.policy.PolicyEngine in the twin (IdentityHome) with phone replies scripted: legitimate requests get a yes, others a no.

replay_models.phone_speaker: B01: band-pass 300-3400 Hz 4th order, tanh clip, RT60 0.3 s, 30 dB
replay_models.bluetooth_speaker: B01: band-pass 120-7500 Hz 2nd order, RT60 0.2 s, 35 dB
replay_models.hifi_speaker: new: 1st-order 60 Hz high-pass, RT60 0.15 s, 40 dB

params.real_guests: LibriSpeech clips from the sherpa-onnx whisper-tiny.en test_wavs folder (0.wav, 1.wav, 8k.wav; 8k.wav is 8 kHz audio)

seed_spread.note: the same pipeline with other seeds: different synthetic rooms, noise and replay draws, same voices and splits. Primary numbers are seed 606.

limitations: Every household voice is ElevenLabs TTS. A TTS voice has the same timbre, microphone and recording chain every time; real people change with colds, mood, distance, age and mic. Real false-reject rates will be higher, and teenagers' voices change over months (re-enrollment), which TTS cannot show.

The household is played by narrator/assistant voices because the S1 character voices have only 1.4-6.2 s each. Only 3 enrolled voices and 4 TTS guest voices plus 3 short real clips: FAR estimates rest on dozens of guest windows and have wide uncertainty. Windows overlap 50 % and come from few files, so trials are correlated; no confidence intervals are reported.
Calibration and evaluation are disjoint in time but come from the same voices and recordings.
Rooms, noise and replay devices are DSP proxies. The liveness check is fitted and tested on the same synthetic room; its low false-reject rate in that room does not transfer (see other_room).
The liveness check learns 'how this household sounds through this microphone'. It catches band-limited or clipped replays, not a good full-range speaker; and nothing here detects a voice clone.
The challenge phrase is modelled on transcripts; no speech recogniser checked spoken phrases, so its own false rejects (ASR errors, accents) are not measured.
Phone approvals are scripted: legitimate requests get a yes, others a no (and 10 % careless yes in a sensitivity run). Real approval fatigue is not measured.
Overlap = two clean windows summed before one room; real overlapping speech differs in timing and position.
Not a biometric system and not anti-spoofing. Research in simulation, provided as is.
